weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.focus: ROTATIONAL STRENGTH FOUNDATIONS: Establish controlled rotational loading, unilateral strength, and hip-torso separation.
weeks.notes:
WEEK 1
ROTATIONAL STRENGTH FOUNDATIONS
Establish controlled rotational loading, unilateral strength, and hip-torso separation.

WORKOUT A FOCUS:
- Hip hinge and lower-body strength
- Rotational control and power foundation
- Connect lower body to upper body
- Build strength without losing mobility

WORKOUT B FOCUS:
- Single-leg strength and balance
- Core stability and anti-rotation control
- Dynamic stability for the golf swing
- Maintain posture under load

WORKOUT C FOCUS:
- Rotational power and sequencing
- Explosive lower-body movement
- Connect strength to swing mechanics
- Improve speed with control

INTERMEDIATE GOLF PROGRAM
WEEK 1 OF 6
3 WORKOUTS PER WEEK
30-35 MINUTES EACH
MOVE BETTER. PLAY BETTER.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.focus: UNILATERAL STRENGTH & STABILITY: Improve trail-leg loading, lead-leg control, and the ability to resist unwanted rotation.
weeks.notes:
WEEK 2
UNILATERAL STRENGTH & STABILITY
Improve trail-leg loading, lead-leg control, and the ability to resist unwanted rotation.

WORKOUT A FOCUS:
- Trail-leg strength and stability
- Hip hinge and rotational control
- Anti-rotation core stability
- Connect lower-body strength to swing mechanics

WORKOUT B FOCUS:
- Lead-leg stability and balance
- Lateral movement and hip control
- Dynamic rotational strength
- Transfer pressure from trail to lead leg

WORKOUT C FOCUS:
- Explosive rotational power
- Dynamic lower-body movement
- Sequencing and speed development
- Translate strength into golf-specific movement

INTERMEDIATE GOLF PROGRAM
WEEK 2 OF 6
3 WORKOUTS PER WEEK
30-35 MINUTES EACH
MOVE BETTER. PLAY BETTER.

weeks.focus: PERFORMANCE & REPEATABILITY: Express improved mobility, power and control while maintaining consistent, repeatable mechanics.
weeks.notes:
WEEK 6
PERFORMANCE & REPEATABILITY
Express improved mobility, power and control while maintaining consistent, repeatable mechanics.

WORKOUT A FOCUS:
- Full-body power and integration
- Explosive lower-body strength
- Rotational strength and coordination
- Transfer strength into a golf-specific swing

WORKOUT B FOCUS:
- Rotational strength under load
- Core stability and anti-rotation
- Single-leg strength and balance
- Control and stability at higher speeds

WORKOUT C FOCUS:
- Speed, sequencing and coordination
- Explosive full-body movement
- Golf-specific rotational power
- Consistency and repeatability under fatigue

INTERMEDIATE GOLF PROGRAM
WEEK 6 OF 6
3 WORKOUTS PER WEEK
30-35 MINUTES EACH
MOVE BETTER. PLAY BETTER.

uncertain: Week 2 Workout A subtitle prints 'improve hip--torso separation' with a doubled hyphen (zoomed 4x); kept as printed. Week 1 prints 'hip-torso' with a single hyphen.

Time boxes and footers print '30–35' with an en dash, and week 3 'Lateral Step-Down (6–12 in)' and the '2–3 seconds' cues (week 5 B5, week 6 C3) also use en dashes; written with an ASCII hyphen per the schema rule.
Week 3 Workout A #1 cue mixes punctuation: 'Load trail leg, rotate explosively, throw from the hips. Finish balanced.' (capital F after a full stop); kept as one cue line as printed.
Week 5 Workout C #5 cue uses arrows: 'sequence hips → torso → arms'; arrows kept as printed (U+2192).
Week 5 Workout A #3 name prints two parentheticals: 'Cable Swing (High to Low) (Explosive)'; kept as printed.
Week 4 Workout C #3 'Rotational Cable Swing (Low to High)' differs in direction from the 'High to Low' cable swings in other weeks; kept as printed.

Several bilateral/each-side inconsistencies kept as printed: TRX Squat, Overhead Pole Squat (weeks 1-2), Trap Bar Deadlift (weeks 4, 6) have no 'each side'; week 3 'Overhead Pole Squat with Rotation' is '3 × 8 each side'.

Only the week 1 sheet's progression strip carries a one-line description under each week title; weeks 2-6 strips show titles only. progression.overview uses the week 1 strip text. Each week's own header box (top right) has a longer description, which is used for that week's 'focus'.

No level goals box, KEY CUES, warm-up, recovery or how-to-progress rules appear on any main-series sheet; top-level goal/principles/dailyBasics left empty. (The ALTERNATE week-1 sheet does have a WEEK 1 GOALS box; it is described in sourceNotes only.)
sourceNotes: Read 6 main-series sheets (1536x1024 each) via Drive thumbnail at sz=w2400, cropped per workout table and upscaled 1.6x (4x for doubtful text): week 1 (1L68xrm3SLrD9EUBODCouwx4qG2UQcfmA), week 2 (1FK_puUUprlKSeRNVvoTarG-EMQ-PrkV8), week 3 (1osycwSKLt-U2owJFPXrc_-N9JPyMME6w), week 4 (1Rk_cuUJ8CkGEgMipeGaQlZUKcS9qbzzr), week 5 (1j053waqudN63LBqzF2qNjpObhdE0s1Pw), week 6 (1NPosNGmsflgO1YodC9OVXMF0O3DjS8cQ). No missing weeks. Every sheet has the same layout: title '6-WEEK INTERMEDIATE GOLF PROGRAM' with tagline, a week header box (title + description), a 6-week progression strip, three tables (WORKOUT A/B/C, each with heading, subtitle and a '30-35 MINUTES' time box, columns # / EXERCISE / SETS x REPS / CUES, 6 rows each) with a WORKOUT FOCUS box (4 bullets) under each, and a footer 'MDFIT ONLINE | INTERMEDIATE GOLF PROGRAM | WEEK n OF 6 | 3 WORKOUTS PER WEEK | 30-35 MINUTES EACH | MOVE BETTER. PLAY BETTER.' Sets x reps printed as '3 x 8 each side' are split into sets '3' and reps '8 each side'; each cue cell is one sentence and is kept as one focus line. ALTERNATE week-1 sheet (1rlVgBJs4tA3Opq4bnWAuZSRLEhTOUDb8, not used as a week): titled 'WEEK 1 / BUILD CAPACITY', it is a different design from the main series. It adds an intro line ('Take your game to the next level. Build on your foundation with increased strength, dynamic movement, and golf-specific power while maintaining mobility and control.'), four benefit icons (GREATER ROTATIONAL POWER, IMPROVED CONTROL, STRONGER LOWER BODY, FUNCTIONAL MOBILITY), a WEEK 1 GOALS box (Reinforce proper movement patterns; Improve mobility through a larger range of motion; Build foundational strength and stability; Prepare the body for increased power and speed), and a different 6-WEEK OUTLINE (1 Build Capacity, 2 Rotational Strength, 3 Speed and Power Development, 4 Integrated Movement, 5 Swing Efficiency, 6 Performance and Assessment, each with 3 bullets) instead of the main series' Rotational Strength Foundations / Unilateral Strength & Stability / Rotational Power Development / Ground Force & Athletic Movement / Speed & Power Integration / Performance & Repeatability. Its workouts are shorter (25-35 MINUTES) but longer lists (8 exercises each, 24 total vs 18) and more mobility-led: Workout A 'MOBILITY & ROTATION FOUNDATION' (e.g. 90/90 Hip Switch with Forward Lean, Couch Stretch with Glute Engagement, Thoracic Rotation (Open Book), Ankle Mobility Rocks, Golf Posture Rotation Drill), Workout B 'STRENGTH & STABILITY' (Glute RDL, Assisted Pistol Squat, Walking Lunge, Single-Leg Glute Bridge, Core Anti-Rotation Pallof Press, Golf Stance Weight Shift), Workout C 'POWER & SWING MECHANICS' (Golfer Switch Row, Light Cable Swing, Lateral Ball Throw, Step-Through Golf Swing, Jump Switch Lunge, Medicine Ball Rotational Scoop, Overhead Pole Squat, Controlled Three-Quarter Swing), mostly 3 x 8-15 (plus 3 x 30 sec and 3 x 20 ft) rather than the main sheet's 3 x 6-10 with loaded unilateral work (Assisted Cossack Squat, Split Squat Rotation Press, Golfer Snatch). In short: the alternate is a gentler, mobility-first entry week tied to a capacity-to-assessment outline, while the main-series week 1 starts straight into rotational strength and power. Its content was not transcribed row by row.
